name: Entity Type Config Export
description: Export content type, block type, paragraph type, vocabulary, and role configuration with selectable modes.
project_description: Entity Type Config Export adds an admin-UI "Export" action to individual content types, block types, paragraph types and vocabularies, plus a page that exports all user roles. Each export gathers the bundle's own configuration (the bundle definition, field instances, field storage, and optionally form/view displays) into per-object YAML files and returns them as a downloadable ZIP, without pulling in unrelated site configuration the way a full `drush cex` would. It offers two modes per bundle: "Selected fields only" (chosen fields plus their storage) and "Full" (all fields, storage and displays). Paragraph reference fields have their referenced paragraph types exported recursively. It is scoped to structural configuration transfer between environments or projects and does not export content, create bundles, or modify existing configuration.
